I knew I wasn't good enough, but I couldn't understand why I hadn't been good enough.

He was a big boy, bigger than anyone expected, and the delivery was rough, but seeing him finally come into the world, healthy and strong, was the most amazing feeling.  It was a moment of pure joy, a moment I'll cherish forever.  He was a little fighter, but he's perfect in every way.

I can't believe I'm actually going to be a student, a real one, not just a kid anymore.
